title: Quick Russian Vegetable Curry
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly Russian dish featuring massaman paste and laminated puff pastry, cooked to perfection in a tandoor clay pot. This crowd-pleasing curry is a perfect blend of cultures and flavors.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor clay pot to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the laminated puff pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
In a large bowl, mix together the massaman paste, grated carrots, diced potatoes, chopped onions, and minced garlic.
Add the vegetable oil, yogurt, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Spoon the curry mixture onto one half of the puff pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the puff pastry over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Brush the top of the pastry with a little water and cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
Place the pastry in the preheated tandoor clay pot and bake for 25 minutes.
Reduce the heat to 350 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the pastry from the pot and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
